purpose: One-time behavioral equivalence proof for isolated part-package migration. These hashes document the migration; future intended geometry edits are not pinned to them.

scope.sourceAndExamplePresets: Exact deep equality of every ID, order, parameter value, source URL, designation, verified dimension and other catalog metadata.
scope.geometry: Every part default in every declared state; all mesh attributes, triangle indices, transforms, component names, mesh counts, triangle counts, exact world bounds, declared dimensions and Python recipe text.
scope.limitations: No new native FreeCAD execution was needed because every emitted part recipe and default geometry are byte-for-byte identical. Parameter extremes and intended future geometry changes continue to use their part tests and parts:check.

workflowChecks.automaticDiscovery: Adding a scaffolded package appeared in the running library without a registry edit.
workflowChecks.liveReplacement: Changing the selected package name, field label and default diameter updated the configurator and geometry; the manually entered length stayed at 24 mm.
workflowChecks.handoffRoundTrip: Exported the temporary package, edited its returned default diameter from 12 to 16 mm, and imported it with --replace. The running preview became 16 x 16 x 24 mm and a backup of the previous package was retained.
workflowChecks.cleanup: The temporary package was moved out of the library; the final production build contains the original 74 parts.
workflowChecks.standaloneWorkbench: Exported bolt-screw and ball-screw-axis handoffs both passed standalone TypeScript and Vite builds. The bolt workbench rendered its own model and generated updated Python after changing the head type.
workflowChecks.productionBuild: Main TypeScript and Vite build passed; the production browser rendered the library and bolt configurator. Vite reports the existing large-chunk advisory for the embedded catalog and geometry dependencies.
workflowChecks.focusedTests: 32 configuration, selection, catalog and package tests plus 15 preset-search tests passed. Application and test/tooling TypeScript checks passed.

coverage: All part folders obey dependency boundaries and registry order.
Source reference assets exist for portable export.
Every package preset file equals its complete runtime preset list.
No mutable configurator, default, preset, state or catalog-selection object is shared between parts.
Every local catalog selector belongs to its own parameter schema.
